receipt.public_excerpt: My time as a special Government employee necessarily had to end.

evidence_items.explanation: Musk acknowledges the end of his formal government position. He also explains that it was time-limited and anticipates remaining an adviser, so this evidence alone would not establish declining political capital.

receipt.public_excerpt: I don't know if we will anymore.

evidence_items.explanation: Trump publicly describes a deterioration in his alliance with Musk within days of the farewell appearance. This directly supports a rapid loss of political standing.

evidence_items.locator: Paragraph on Musk's perceived influence in the Trump administration
evidence_items.explanation: The July 2–7 survey places Musk's perceived influence at a limited level among most Republicans. The report also says he retained substantial Republican support, limiting any claim that his political influence had disappeared.

receipt.public_excerpt: consistent with the poll in April

evidence_items.explanation: Overall unfavorable opinion did not materially increase between April and June. This counters a popularity-only interpretation, but does not negate the documented deterioration in his presidential alliance.

unresolved_gaps: The records do not quantify private access or Musk's ability to secure particular policy decisions.
